See comments on https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/103663#issuecomment-2704939777 for some analysis.

It seems a bit weird to me that the regular ResourceSaver save logic triggers a load of a yet-unwritten file for UID logic. Sounds like a potential bug that's not just limited to the test suite.

CC @KoBeWi

The problem is that ResourceSaver tries to write file's UID, so it tries to determine it first and fallbacks to ResourceLoader (because there is no cache), which sees the file, but it's empty, because it's being saved right now. Not sure how to resolve that. Maybe ResourceLoader could stop loading the file when it's empty and it's being processed by ResourceSaver, but it might be not easy to detect that.
